newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat back to its waiting game.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat back to its waiting game.

text.p: Wheat futures reverted to quiet trading on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Wednesday with a spread over the January/March contracts the only activity.
January 1997 fell by 50 cents to A$191.00 while March fell A$1.50 to A$192.00.
Five lots traded of each contract, with a local trader selling January and buying March.
"It was pretty quite. There was a bit of option interest but nothing traded," said Sam Mende of McIntosh Futures Ltd.
"The market's just waiting to see will happen in the U.S.," he said.
